# ffxf_usage (Data Source)

Lists paginated account usage records and their total.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_usage" "month" {
  group_by = "hour"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) Inclusive beginning of the usage interval as an RFC3339 timestamp.
- `group_by` (String) Group records by hour or virtual machine; defaults to hour.
- `to` (String) Exclusive end of the usage interval as an RFC3339 timestamp.
- `vm_id` (Number) Limit usage to this virtual machine identifier.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency for the total.
- `records` (Attributes List) Usage records across all API pages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `total` (String) Total amount as a decimal string.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Amount as a decimal string.
- `currency` (String) Currency code.
- `hostname` (String) VM hostname, when applicable.
- `hours` (Number) Billable hours.
- `kind` (String) Usage kind, such as vm or github_runners.
- `period_start` (String) Start of this billing period.
- `rate` (String) Rate as a decimal string.
- `rate_unit` (String) Rate unit, hour or minute.
- `vm_id` (Number) VM identifier, or null for non-VM usage.
